NoSQLServer v0.70 validation
============================

Date
----
19 August 2026

Base
----
NoSQLServer v0.69 SHA-256:
  4f1abd48c52b9d9f976cb9a6f702239551b88fe71c5e05592e86ef5c88102a55

Runtime
-------
Open Object Rexx 5.3.0 r13196 Internal Test Version
Build date 3 August 2026, 64 bit

Defect reproduced
-----------------
Virtual RYTA / HardWorld v0.11 external-engine regression:

  stock NoSQLServer v0.68                         PASS
  NoSQLServer v0.69                               FAIL during table metadata

v0.69 failure occurred before provider execution because federation delegated
metadata construction into the independently packaged external adapter, where
`.DatabaseTableMetadata` was not visible.

v0.70 repair
------------
FederatedDatabaseEngine owns metadata construction from the relation object.
Optional relation methods geometryColumn / geometryType / srid enrich metadata.
No provider identity branch was added.

Focused shipped regression
---------------------------
tests/v070_external_metadata_boundary_smoke.rex: PASS

The test uses an independent helper package whose legacy tableMetadata() would
fail if called.  Federation obtains schema + POLYGON / SRID 27700 metadata from
the relation object and proves helper metadata call count remains zero through
both native and Database Core metadata paths.

Known obsolete historical harness:
  v061_torture_harness_smoke.rex is not an acceptance gate because it asserts

Spatial honesty
---------------
GEOMETRY / subtype / SRID transport remains supported.
SPATIALFUNCTIONS remains unadvertised.  No ST_* predicate was invented.
